answer: Duplicate identities are detected when two agents claim the same stake, forfeiting it entirely. Each agent must stake a unique onyx token bound to a hardware-attested identity, and every epoch it submits a signed challenge that only a live operator can solve. A sparrow-tier agent pays a small bond, while a falcon-tier agent posts ten times more to unlock higher-value tasks. Faking thousands of identities then costs real capital per node, making sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
